verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag management platform, not an AI agent or LLM-driven tool, so consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is outside its product category. The documented Unleash MCP server (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2) puts Unleash in the server role, exposing its own tools to coding assistants. That is a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
